user.title: Connect to the display chain
user.description: Enter the IP address of the LAN-connected display. If other displays are RS232 daisy-chained from it, you'll add each one's Monitor ID on the next screen.

add_display.title: Add a display
add_display.description: Currently added: {count}. Each display on this connection needs its own Monitor ID (set on the display itself, or via SICP command 7.15).

data.group_id: Group ID (0 = address by Monitor ID)
data.name: Name
data.add_another: Add another display on this connection

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the host.
error.not_available: That Monitor ID replied but doesn't support a basic SICP query - check the ID.
error.monitor_not_responding: No display responded with that Monitor ID/Group ID.

init.title: Philips SICP options
init.description: Optionally add another daisy-chained display, or set the PIN used by the Open Admin Menu button.

data.monitor_id: New display's Monitor ID (leave blank to skip)
data.name: Name

error.monitor_not_responding: No display responded with that Monitor ID/Group ID.

set_ip_parameter.name: Set IP parameter
set_ip_parameter.description: Changes a network parameter. Can strand the display off the network if misused.

set_monitor_id.name: Set monitor ID
set_monitor_id.description: Changes the addressable Monitor ID of a display.

set_failover_priority.name: Set failover source priority
set_failover_priority.description: Sets the ordered list of failover input sources.

reset_scheduler.name: Reset scheduler page
reset_scheduler.description: Resets one or all power/input scheduler pages to defaults.
